race.comment: EDUCATED (6) was just overrun late first up at Caulfield where Jabez Johnstone kept her very wide out of the chute start and was just nabbed on the line. She'd shown good ability last time in and gets every chance on the map here. With the main danger out it does look her race to lose. SET ME LOOSE (12) is a progressive mare with good speed who sets up well on speed, she'll give a sight up with EDUCATED. SPIRIT OF WEALTH (11) resumes for a new yard, watch the betting but she's got ability an draws well. BEDOURIE (9) resumes. He didn't really fire last time in but has ability on his day and could surprise.
